tags.label: Noun gender
tags.description: Wrong gender for a noun (shows up in its article or adjective).

tags.label: Noun plural
tags.description: Wrong singular or plural form of a noun.

tags.label: Article form
tags.description: Wrong article form for the following sound (il/lo/l', un/uno/un').

tags.label: Article use
tags.description: Article missing, extra, or definite and indefinite swapped.

tags.label: Adjective agreement
tags.description: Adjective does not agree in gender or number with its noun.

tags.label: Subject-verb agreement
tags.description: Verb person or number does not match the subject.

tags.label: Verb form
tags.description: Non-existent or wrong conjugated form, often a regularised irregular verb.

tags.label: Essere or avere
tags.description: Essere and avere swapped outside the perfect tenses (age, hunger, cold...).

tags.label: C'è / ci sono
tags.description: Wrong form or missing ci in 'there is / there are'.

tags.label: Negation
tags.description: Missing or misplaced non, or wrong double negative.

tags.label: Question form
tags.description: Wrong question word or English-style question structure.

tags.label: Modal + infinitive
tags.description: Modal verb not followed by a bare infinitive.

tags.label: Preposition choice
tags.description: Wrong simple preposition (a/in/di/da/per/con/su).

tags.label: Articulated preposition
tags.description: Preposition and article not combined, or combined wrongly.

example.wrong: Il libro è su il tavolo.

tags.label: Questo / quello
tags.description: Wrong form of questo or quello.

tags.label: Possessives
tags.description: Wrong possessive form, or article used with a singular family noun.

tags.label: Piacere construction
tags.description: Piacere built like English 'like' (subject/object reversed or wrong number).

tags.label: Auxiliary choice
tags.description: Avere used instead of essere in the perfect tenses, or the reverse.

tags.label: Past participle form
tags.description: Regularised or wrong past participle.

tags.label: Participle agreement
tags.description: Participle does not agree after essere or a preceding object pronoun.

tags.label: Reflexive verbs
tags.description: Reflexive pronoun missing or wrong.

tags.label: Object pronoun choice
tags.description: Wrong direct or indirect object pronoun (lo/la/gli/le).

tags.label: Pronoun position
tags.description: Clitic pronoun in the wrong place.

tags.label: Passato prossimo vs imperfetto
tags.description: Perfective and imperfective past swapped.

example.wrong: Da bambino sono andato al mare ogni estate.
example.right: Da bambino andavo al mare ogni estate.

tags.label: Imperfetto form
tags.description: Wrong imperfetto form.

example.wrong: Da piccolo andevo a scuola a piedi.
example.right: Da piccolo andavo a scuola a piedi.

tags.label: Future form
tags.description: Wrong simple future form.

tags.label: Stare + gerund
tags.description: Wrong progressive form (essere + gerund, wrong gerund).

tags.label: Imperative form
tags.description: Wrong imperative form, including negative tu imperative and Lei forms.

tags.label: Comparatives
tags.description: Wrong comparative structure (di/che, più buono/migliore).

example.wrong: Roma è più grande che Milano.
example.right: Roma è più grande di Milano.

tags.label: Ci and ne
tags.description: Ci or ne missing or used wrongly.

tags.label: Conditional form
tags.description: Wrong conditional form, or present used where politeness needs the conditional.

tags.label: Relative pronouns
tags.description: Wrong relative pronoun (che/cui/il quale).

example.wrong: La ragazza di che ti ho parlato.
example.right: La ragazza di cui ti ho parlato.

tags.label: Combined pronouns
tags.description: Wrong combined pronoun form or order.

tags.label: Subjunctive needed
tags.description: Indicative used where the subjunctive is required, or the reverse.

tags.label: Subjunctive form
tags.description: Wrong subjunctive form.

tags.label: Hypothetical sentences
tags.description: Wrong tense pairing in se-clauses.

tags.label: Passive voice
tags.description: Wrong passive construction or agreement.

tags.label: Word order
tags.description: Words in an unnatural or wrong order (often adjective position or adverbs).

tags.label: Word choice
tags.description: Wrong or unnatural word, including calques from the learner's first language.

tags.label: False friend
tags.description: A word that looks like the learner's L1 word but means something else.

example.wrong: Sono molto eccitato per la festa.
example.right: Sono molto emozionato per la festa.

tags.label: Spelling and accents
tags.description: Misspelling, missing double consonant or accent (e/è, perche/perché).

tags.label: Register (tu / Lei)
tags.description: Informal tu where formal Lei is expected, or the reverse, or a mix of both.

example.wrong: Scusa, puoi dirmi dov'è la stazione? (to a stranger, formal setting)
example.right: Scusi, può dirmi dov'è la stazione?
